name: Step One: Rock
summary: Hamur in Bolder'ok wants good rocks from the river nearby. Bring them so he can make a tiny weapon for a tiny creature.

sections.title: Hamur's Request
sections.body: Hamur in Bolder'ok says you are too small to wield a good ogre weapon. He offers to make you a tiny one if you bring him good rocks. He wants rocks from the river outside Bolder'ok, where only the best stones will do.

faq.answer: Hamur is in Bolder'ok and offers to make you a tiny weapon if you bring him good rocks.

faq.q: Where do I find the rocks?
faq.answer: Hamur asks for good rocks from the river outside Bolder'ok.
Hamur says he will use the good rocks to make a tiny weapon for a tiny creature.

faq.q: What kind of rocks does Hamur want?
faq.answer: Hamur wants good rocks from the river outside Bolder'ok; he says not every rock is suitable.
